Expected results

  • Step 1: a drag starts and a small preview box with {Work-order-1}'s work order number and customer name follows the pointer.
  • Step 2: the whole customer name stays inside the preview box. A name too long to fit is cut off with "…" (or wraps onto another line inside the box). No letter of it is drawn outside the box or over the neighbouring columns and cards.
  • Step 3: the drag is cancelled and {Work-order-1}'s card stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 4: Tech View shows {Work-order-1}'s row in {Technician-A}'s group.
  • Step 5: a drag starts and a small preview box with {Work-order-1}'s work order number and customer name follows the pointer.
  • Step 6: the whole customer name stays inside the preview box. A name too long to fit is cut off with "…" (or wraps onto another line inside the box). No letter of it is drawn outside the box or over the neighbouring rows.
  • Step 7: the drag is cancelled and {Work-order-1}'s row stays in {Technician-A}'s group.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 64 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S9-R1, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html": the customer name on a Board View card and on a Tech View row is cut off with "…" when it is too long, read 19 Oct 2026. Tech plan (upload of 8 Oct 2026), the drag files row (Escape cancels a drag). Related ticket: SV-11503. Source-verified 19 October 2026; the design confirmation of 23 Oct 2026 added 26 Oct 2026. Last checked against QA branch sv11503 (fix for SV-11503, build v26.43.1-a53a4ac) on 10/26/2026.

The PRD has no rule for the drag preview itself, and the design does not draw one. This case applies the design's cut-off of customer names on cards and rows to the preview, by the QA lead's decision of 19 Oct 2026. On 23 Oct 2026 the design was confirmed by Branko Cicovic, as recorded by Slavcho Mitrov on SV-11503 (quoted below).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R1: “Allow dragging work orders within or between technician groups/columns in Tech View and Board View.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View card customer name: “<span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: {{ wo.titleColor }}; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">{{ wo.cust }}</span>”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View row customer name: “<span style="font-size: {{ cellFs }}; font-weight: 500; color: {{ wo.titleColor }}; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">{{ wo.cust }}</span>”
  • Design confirmation, SV-11503 comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 23 Oct 2026: “Design confirmed (Branko, 23 Oct): a long customer name in the drag preview is cut to one line ending in "…", the same as on the card in the column.”
  • Tech plan, drag files row: “Pointer-events drag: threshold (SQ-10) exported as a named constant and documented so tests can exceed it deterministically, rAF auto-scroll, Escape cancels, click suppressed after a drag”
